package domain

import "strings"

// LearningTargetType is the stable semantic kind of an authored task target.
type LearningTargetType string

const (
	LearningTargetConcept    LearningTargetType = "concept"
	LearningTargetCapability LearningTargetType = "capability"
)

// TaskLearningTarget links one canonical task to an opaque curriculum target.
// Course stores the reference but does not interpret mastery or graph semantics.
type TaskLearningTarget struct {
	TaskID  string
	Type    LearningTargetType
	Key     string
	Version string
	Order   int
}

// NormalizeTaskLearningTargets validates and deterministically orders authored targets.
func NormalizeTaskLearningTargets(targets []TaskLearningTarget) ([]TaskLearningTarget, error) {
	if len(targets) > 100 {
		return nil, ErrValidation
	}
	result := make([]TaskLearningTarget, len(targets))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
	for index, target := range targets {
		if target.Type != LearningTargetConcept && target.Type != LearningTargetCapability {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		key, err := NormalizeContentSourceKey(target.Key)
		if err != nil || key == "" {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		version := strings.TrimSpace(target.Version)
		if len(version) > 128 {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		identity := string(target.Type) + "\x00" + key + "\x00" + version
		if _, duplicate := seen[identity]; duplicate {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		seen[identity] = struct{}{}
		result[index] = TaskLearningTarget{
			TaskID:  strings.TrimSpace(target.TaskID),
			Type:    target.Type,
			Key:     key,
			Version: version,
			Order:   index,
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}
